purpose: Fresh same-tool/same-argv observation applying the original classifier separately to every strict NDJSON object. Only individually admitted event vocabulary is published; every semantic rejection remains an explicit unknown object.

original_time_evidence.qualification: Conservative wall-clock envelope from same original job ACK creation and terminal publication, supported by bootstrap-intent record; not an exact wall-clock timestamp for posix_spawn. No timezone inferred from ps lstart and no guessed monotonic-to-epoch conversion.

individually_admitted_projection.name: log_projection
individually_admitted_projection.input: The original full line encoded in UTF8 plus one LF; not reconstructed JSON. The original child row and empty actual stderr are supplied.
individually_admitted_projection.gates: Original nonempty/equal string message candidates, exact label token, typed process/basename launchd, exact timestamp parsing and original three-second bounds.
individually_admitted_projection.admittedOutput: The entire original classifier row with only ordinal replaced by its actual original object ordinal. Category/errno/path vocabulary remains identical.

explicit_unknown_rejections.timestampRationale: Strict duplicate/nonfinite-constant/object JSON parsing happens before the semantic catch, on the identical immutable line. ValueError/OverflowError in the original classifier's datetime path becomes this fixed reason; no exception string/value is published.
explicit_unknown_rejections.notCaught: All nonlisted HelpRefused (including deadline/cancellation), Unicode/JSON structural errors, unexpected exceptions, hard bounds and closure errors remain whole-observer failure.
explicit_unknown_rejections.disposition: Every object is in exactly one of events or rejectedObjects; ordinal and fixed reason are preserved. No rejected object is omitted or described as known harmless.

output_semantics.observedObjects: all complete nonblank strict object lines
output_semantics.admittedEvents: only rows returned by the original whole classifier
output_semantics.rejectedObjects: ordinal, one fixed rejectionReason, fixed meaning unknown_object_not_admitted
output_semantics.allObservedObjectsAdmitted: derived only from rejected count, never source-of-truth root-cause authority
output_semantics.topLevelOk: Only bounded observation, disposition and owned closure completed. It does not assert all objects classified or cause known; those explicit flags remain false even when event count is positive.

sequence: Whole exact GO and dedicated fresh slot with the exact typed-stdin digest/fingerprint.
Publish exact request/intent/armed whole; independent boundary; one unique process_start only.
Archive full original SDK externally before parse/isError; UNKNOWN preserves original identity, no replay/re-key.
Only the returned original mac job status/streams with original observer IDs and contiguous next8192 immutable pages under original1MiB cap.
Close full durable original streams/observers and prove actual child reaped/owned group empty/fourFDs/unchanged tool/fullSHA/shared45 before assessing per-object observations.
lane_activation: A may activate one lane now; C0 after independent report INFO closure and may use one lane under separate body GO. B0/root0; maximum2 globally, one Native call/future each.
requires_actual: Known parent outcome, complete durable original streams and inactive observers.

Every complete nonblank object has exactly one original ordinal in admitted events or explicit unknown rejections; strict malformed/duplicate/nonfinite/nonobject or hard bound failures still fail the observation.
An admitted event must pass the unchanged original label/process/timestamp gates and exposes only original closed category/errno/known-path vocabulary.
Unknown objects retain unknown meaning; no implicit header/statistics/harmless classification.
One log child owned/reaped/group empty/streams closed, four FDs closed and original45/10/60 bounds unchanged.

interpretation.success: Only bounded per-object observation and owned cleanup completed. Positive event count does not qualify whole log or startup cause.
interpretation.unknown_rows: Explicit rejectedUnknownObjects with closed reason and original ordinal; never silently omitted.
interpretation.event_mentions: Lexical evidence only; a path or errno mention does not by itself prove causality.
interpretation.fresh_not_recovered: A fresh query of same historical interval, never recovery/equality proof for old817 bytes.
interpretation.old_failure: Original query exit1 remains a known failed projection.
interpretation.limits: Accepted-byte caps do not trace log datastore scanning; unchanged pipe helper may receive one crossing block before rejection.

excluded: old-label cleanup or old PID signalling
replaying failed query or assuming new output equals prior817 bytes
